etsy.title: Easy Crochet Snowflake Pattern PDF, Beginner Christmas Ornament Crochet Pattern, 3 Rounds, Gift Tag Snowflake, English + German
etsy.description:
A quick, pretty snowflake in just 3 rounds, about 30 minutes. Make a dozen for your tree, gift tags or a window garland.

• Skill level: easy
• Size: about 9 cm (3.5 in) with DK cotton
• Hook: 3.5 mm (US E/4)
• Yarn: about 5 g white cotton

New pattern. The first image is a simple diagram of the finished shape; a maker-tested photo will be added.
PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download: English PDF (US terms, UK table) + German PDF (Deutsch).
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked round by round.
